BACK ON MARKET. No Fault of Seller. This beautifully upgraded single story home offers nearly 2,700 square feet of living space in the highly desired Heritage Lake community. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths and a spacious 3 car garage, this home combines style, comfort and exceptional indoor outdoor living with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and distant mountains.
Step inside to an open and inviting floor plan filled with natural light and gorgeous luxury vinyl plank flooring. At the heart of the home is the stunning kitchen featuring white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop, electric oven and an oversized center island perfect for gathering and entertaining. The kitchen opens to the spacious great room featuring a cozy fireplace, oversized ceiling fan. A formal dining room and separate breakfast room provide additional space for dining and entertaining.
The spacious primary suite offers a large walk in closet, private bath with dual sinks, soaking tub and separate shower with built in bench. Three additional bedrooms provide plenty of space for family, guests or a home office. The laundry room includes a deep utility sink, cabinetry and shelving. The 3 car garage offers a workshop area, workbench & storage.

Step outside to the expansive covered California Room, creating the perfect extension of the indoor living space for relaxing, dining and entertaining. The beautifully landscaped, low maintenance backyard offers a spacious patio for outdoor dining and barbecuing, plus areas for bocce ball, horseshoes and outdoor games. Enjoy peaceful views of the surrounding landscape and distant mountains, including snow capped peaks in winter and colorful hot air balloons during balloon season.
Additional upgrades include custom underground drainage, newer rain gutters and a whole house soft water and purification system, plus alkaline drinking water in the kitchen.
Heritage Lake residents enjoy a private 25 acre lake with walking trails, catch and release fishing and non motorized boating, a resort style pool overlooking the lake, splash park, playgrounds and scenic walking paths. Heritage Park offers lighted basketball, pickleball and tennis courts, plus covered gathering areas for barbecues and picnics.
Beautifully upgraded and surrounded by some of Heritage Lake's best amenities, this exceptional home offers the space, views, lifestyle and location buyers have been waiting for. AN ABSOLUTE MUST SEE!

results.remarks: If you're looking for privacy and affordability then this home with a VA ASSUMABLE INTEREST RATE of 2.75%, is the one. Located in the highly desirable community of Audie Murphy Ranch in Menifee, this stunning 5-bedroom, 3-bath home offers over $40,000 in backyard landscaping appointed with romantic mesquite trees lining the yard to create a private oasis. As you enter the almost 2700 sqft property you are greeted by tall ceilings, LVP floors, custom paint high-end fabric window treatments and gorgeous furnishings that are negotiable with the property. The main floor features a large bedroom and a full bath boasting a tub/shower combo. The Great room is illuminated by natural light flooding through the large windows and into the generously sized dining room perfect even as a flex space. The gourmet kitchen features quartz counters, grey cabinets, an eat-up island, stainless steel appliances including a stainless-steel fridge, and a large walk-in pantry. The mudroom leads the way to the 3-car tandem garage. The home offers ample storage through large closets on both floors. The second story boasts a cozy loft and a spacious laundry room with built-in cabinetry for additional storage, complete with a washer and dryer. Two of the three secondary bedrooms are generously sized and feature plush carpeting and standard closets. The third bedroom is equally spacious, offering a unique office nook, a walk-in closet, and plush carpeting. The massive primary suite boasts gorgeous views of the private yard and a custom barn door to the large bath featuring a soaking tub, walk-in shower and massive walk-in closet.The private yard has been curated to offer privacy and beauty featuring custom pavers, a large CA room, a custom brick fireplace and drought-tolerant lush landscaping with Mesquite trees that do not need watering including a large side yard featuring artificial turf. The community offers pools, a spa, clubhouse, walking and biking trails, a skate park, sports parks and the award-winning Taawila Elementary School which is rated the number one school in Menifee and the new Kathryn Newport Middle School. The community is located between the 15and 215 freeways, close to shopping and dining. This home is walking distance to the main clubhouse, multiple trails, and the middle school. Audie Murphy Ranch HOA offers many community activities such as Saturday morning yoga, kids clubs, DJ's by the pool, children's story hour, movie nights and much more!

results.remarks:
Tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac just blocks from the lake, this home sits on an oversized lot with room to breathe. Inside, cathedral ceilings and oversized windows set the tone in the living room, bathing the space in natural light and flowing easily into the dining area. For everyday living, the family room delivers with a warm fireplace and an open connection to the kitchen, where two-tone cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances meet a picture window framing backyard views. It's a kitchen built for both function and style. A downstairs bedroom adds flexibility, ideal for hosting guests, running a home office, or setting up a playroom. Upstairs, the remaining bedrooms are generously sized, giving everyone their own comfortable space. The primary suite stands out with elevated ceilings, a walk-in closet, dual-sink vanity, and a shower/tub combo designed for unwinding.
Out back, the possibilities are wide open, think summer barbecues, birthday celebrations, weekend hangouts, or even a future pool. The lifestyle doesn't stop at the property line: residents enjoy access to a private club, lakeside jogging and biking trails, fishing, sports courts, and playgrounds throughout the community. With shopping and everyday conveniences just minutes away across the 215, this home offers a rare mix of lakeside living and everyday ease, a genuine fresh start in a neighborhood built for it.

No HOA | Single-Story Living!

Welcome to 31285 Palomar Road in Menifee, where single-story convenience meets everyday comfort in a community with no HOA restrictions. Situated on a 0.17-acre lot minutes away from Mt. San Jacinto College, Bell Mountain Middle School, and neighborhood parks, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 2,376 square feet of functional living space built in 2004.

From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by an open and connected floor plan that flows seamlessly from the spacious kitchen into the dining area and family room, making it ideal for entertaining and everyday living alike. A cozy fireplace anchors the family room, creating a warm and welcoming gathering space.

The kitchen offers a walk-in pantry and a generous island/breakfast bar, keeping you connected to the main living areas whether you are cooking a weekday dinner or hosting family and friends.The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with its own private bathroom. The two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office, giving you the freedom to shape the space around your lifestyle.
Step outside to a well-sized lot with room to personalize and make your own. With no HOA, you have the freedom to add a pool, garden, or simply enjoy the outdoor space however you like.

This is a great opportunity to own a comfortable, move-in ready single-story home in one of Menifee's most convenient and accessible neighborhoods.

The versatile floor plan features a spacious primary suite and a junior suite, each offering generous walk-in closets and private ensuite bathrooms—perfect for hosting guests or accommodating multi-generational living. **This home qualifies for a $20,000 grant which can be used for down payment and/or closing costs**5 BEDROOMS • OVER 3,100 SQ FT • HUGE BACKYARD BUILT FOR ENTERTAINING! This spacious Menifee home offers an impressive 3,117 square feet of living space, 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and an oversized 9,148-square-foot lot with the kind of backyard that's getting harder to find.

Step inside to a bright, open floor plan featuring extensive tile flooring throughout the main living areas, abundant recessed lighting, a formal dining room, and a spacious family room with fireplace. The kitchen opens to the main living space and offers rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a large center island with seating, and plenty of counter and storage space. With five bedrooms, this home provides excellent flexibility for a home office, guest room, playroom, or multigenerational living. The primary suite features a spacious bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub, separate glass-enclosed shower, and generous closet space. An oversized laundry room provides additional cabinetry and storage.

The backyard is where this property really stands apart. Multiple outdoor living areas include a covered patio for dining and relaxing, a separate paver patio with a built-in BBQ island, large grass areas, mature landscaping, a dedicated play area, and an additional expansive side/rear yard offering even more usable space. Vinyl fencing adds privacy, while the size and layout of the lot provide plenty of room to entertain, play, garden, or create your own outdoor retreat. 

Conveniently located in Menifee with access to shopping, dining, recreation and the I-215 corridor, this home delivers the combination buyers are searching for: space inside, space outside, and a versatile 5-bedroom floor plan.
